about: Lot 314 (the third bug hunt, BUG-83): NN-L-IOU-002 fires once per process. The sensor sends the cumulative bitmap of a process's io_uring opcode classes with every new class and again at most once a second, with the opcode of that moment. An implant opens a file, connects (the record completing the file+network pair: the verdict), reads, sends, and goes on (periodic records); a server accepts, reads (the verdict), then reads and writes. One verdict each; on main every later record whose last opcode was a file or network one fired again (5 and 3 verdicts).

decision.name: io_uring file and network I/O from the same unlisted process
decision.reasoning: `evil` drives both file I/O and network I/O through io_uring rings (file_open, net_connect): reads, writes and connections that never pass through openat/connect/sendto — the blind-channel exfiltration/implant shape (RingReaper class). Alert only: legitimate io_uring servers are exempted by executable.
